Dia tidak mahu ada cucu yang lahir dari rahim pembunuh. Ketika Nilla dan Zein bercuti, studio Zein dicerobohi dan barang-barng dirosakkan. Ketika menunggu Zein balik dari kerja, penceroboh upahan masuk ke rumah Nilla dan cuba untuk menakutkan dan menggugurkan kandungan Nilla.

sensasi.title: Mr Delicious
sensasi.desc: Satu ujian besar menentukan sama ada cinta mampu menyatukan semula mereka.

sensasi.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
sensasi.desc: Jazlan menasihatkan adiknya Jazlee untuk membuktikan kepada bekas teman wanitanya yang dia bukanlah lelaki lembik seperti yang disangka. Ibu Jazlan, Alawiyah dan ibu Qasih, Khatijah merancang untuk merapatkan Jazlan dengan Qasih dengan berpura-pura ingin melawat kawan mereka yang sakit dan menyuruh Jazlan membawa Qasih pulang dari Masjid dan kerana terpaksa Jazlan menyuruh Qasih duduk di belakang. Jazlee dilarang oleh Jazlan untuk menyertai pertandingan yang memperagakan tubuh badan lelaki dan mendedahkan aurat. Aishah mencari jalan untuk mendekati Jazlan dan Fatimah pula masih menyimpan perasaannya terhadap Jazlan

sensasi.title: Another Love
sensasi.desc: Mahkamah menawarkan Kenan perjanjian—membantu membongkar sisa-sisa terakhir Projek S-1 sebagai pertukaran untuk pengurangan hukuman. Dia menerima, tetapi itu bermakna meninggalkan Leyla sekali lagi.

sensasi.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
sensasi.desc: Semasa sibuk menyiapkan dewan untuk program Jihad palestine, teman lelaki Qasih bernama Rudy datang dengan berseluar pendek, membawakan makanan untuk Qasih dan kehadirannya betul-betul memalukan Khatijah. degup.title: Obsesi Dia EP15
degup.desc: Alia dan Susan tertangkap. Adam sempat meyelamatkan mereka yang hampir dibunuh Dr Zahir. Zacky turut terselamat manakala Dr Zahir ditahan polis. Ritz yang dalam tahanan lelaki bertopeng dipaksa memanggil Alia datang kelokasi mereka. Lelaki bertopeng memanggil Adam datang kelokasi yang sama. Zacky tiba dilokasi bersama Alia. Berlaku pertarungan antara Zacky dan lelaki bertopeng. Adam menembak kaki lelaki bertopeng untuk menyelamatkan Zacky. Dalam masa yang sama Alia dan Kai pergi menyelamatkan Ritz. Mereka semua terkejut apabila mendapati lelaki bertopeng itu sebenarnya Rafeeq yang juga adik kembar Adam. Mereka berdua bersaing dalam misi membalas dendam terhadap Tan Seri Jalaludin yang telah merampas harta dan membunuh ibu bapa mereka. Adam menembak Rafeeq sebelum menembak Tan Seri Jalaludin. Selepas kejadian Adam meminta Zacky menyerahkanya kepada pihak berkuasa

degup.title: Paku
degup.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan tentang Fahmi (Johan As'ari) yang amat mencintai isterinya Riana (Aishah Ilias) dan dia tidak dapat menerima kenyataan bahawa isterinya sudah meninggal dunia. Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

degup.title: Brick Mansion
degup.desc: Di Detroit dystopian, rumah besar yang pernah menempatkan orang kaya kini menjadi rumah penjenayah paling berbahaya di bandar itu. Di sekeliling kawasan itu terdapat tembok gergasi untuk memastikan seluruh Detroit selamat. Bagi polis yang menyamar Damien Collier, setiap hari adalah perjuangan menentang rasuah ketika dia berjuang untuk membawa pembunuh bapanya, Tremaine, ke muka pengadilan. Sementara itu, Damien dan bekas penipu bernama Lino bekerjasama untuk menyelamatkan bandar itu daripada komplot untuk memusnahkannya.

degup.title: The Midwich Cuckoos EP1
degup.desc: Seluruh penduduk Midwich pengsan secara misteri. Selepas sedar, kesan aneh mula timbul terutama dalam kalangan wanita.

degup.title: Bisikan Pontianak
degup.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

degup.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP3
degup.desc: Rodi siasat sindiket penculikan, berdepan dilema antara tugas dan menyelamatkan Kasyorga. Reza sembunyi budak di rumah Kak Esah. Rahsia Mak Siti terbongkar. Rodi menjejak Rajoo di tengah laut.

degup.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP4
degup.desc: Rodi selamatkan beberapa kanak-kanak tapi bukan Kasyorga. Reza gagal patuhi arahan bunuh Esah. Rodi bunuh Reza dan Zaza. Rahsia terbongkar: Kasyorga masih hidup, tetapi diseksa.

degup.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP5
degup.desc: Rodi diburu polis selepas membunuh Rajoo demi menyelamatkan ibunya, Juita, yang akhirnya terbunuh. Kesnya jadi sensasi media, mengangkat isu ketidakadilan sosial terhadap anak jalanan seperti Kasyorga.

degup.title: Hani
degup.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

degup.title: Dabbe Bir Cin Vakasi

salamhd.title: Menantu Tok Sintok
salamhd.desc: Sejak belajar mengaji dengan Tok Sintok dan berjaya menghafal pelbagai surah pendek, Azhan dan Badrul sedikit sebanyak mula berubah. Mereka sudah rajin solat dan mula bangun solat Subuh walaupun selama ini tak pernah solat Subuh. Mereka tetap bekerja sebagai samseng tarik kereta. Tetapi, mereka rasa bersalah menjadi samseng dan terasa tak selesa. Mereka terpaksa juga kerja untuk teruskan kehidupan dan berhasrat cari kerja lain. Mereka senyap-senyap interview kerja lain tapi gaji pula kecil.

salamhd.desc: Episod ini akan membicarakan mengenai sahabat nabi iaitu Abu Darda' Al-Ansari r.a. Jika meraka melihatnya, mendengarnya, atau berada di hadapan baginda walau sekejap mereka dianggap sebagai sahabat nabi s.a.w.

salamhd.title: Menu Viral
salamhd.desc: Episod kali ini bersama Cef Naem akan berada di Jibril dan akan merasa masakan viral iaitu Saled Egg Butter Chicken. Cef akan merasa menu yang viral tersebut sebelum berjumpa dengan tukang masak restoran untuk melihat sendiri resipi yang digunakan.

salamhd.title: Perempuan Tepi Jalan
salamhd.desc: Umi dan Aira orang yang paling bahagia di hari pernikahan Maya dan Ferdaus. Manakala Bella pula orang yang paling sedih.Hari-hari ada saja cara Ferdaus nak 'mengacau' Maya. Meski dia tahu Maya lemas dengan semua perhatian yang diberikannya tapi demi menambat hati isterinya . Ferdaus merasakan Maya telah melampau batas apabila Maya menuduhnya cuba mengambil kesempatan sedangkan dia ikhlas pada Maya. Ini membuatkan Ferdaus merajuk dan enggan bercakap dengan Maya.

salamhd.title: Artis Mengaji
salamhd.desc: Bersama Ustazah Aishah Bain akan mengajar dan membimbing artis jemputan dengan bacaan yang betul dan episod kali ini bersama Elynn Ariffin yang akan mengupas surah Al-Masad . Secara ringkasnya, Al - Quran merupakan kitab lengkap yang membimbing manusia ke jalan Allah. Kandungan kitab itu sentiasa relevan dengan kehidupan manusia meskipun dunia menghadapi pelbagai perubahan.

salamhd.desc: Azhan dan Badrul merupakan sahabat setia yang kacak dan berbadan sado. Mereka berdua bekerja menarik kereta. Azhan dan Badrul mealalui masalah cinta yang berkait antara satu sama lain.

salamhd.title: Ali Alia
salamhd.desc: Kehilangan Ali dan Alia membuatkan Amir dan Mazni mula panik. Dalam usaha mencari mereka, pasangan itu mula menilai kembali kesilapan yang pernah dilakukan sebagai ibu bapa.

salamhd.title: Deko Ibadah
salamhd.desc: Team Deko Ibadah kali ini berada di Surau Taman Desa Genting, Balik Pulau. Deko Ibadah berkongsi inspirasi menghias dan menyusun ruang ibadah yang selesa, praktikal serta menenangkan. Menggabungkan elemen dekorasi dan pengisian Islam, program ini membantu mewujudkan persekitaran yang lebih kondusif untuk beribadah dan menghayati nilai-nilai murni.

salamhd.title: Superhero Hati
salamhd.desc: Suhana yang terlalu kecewa dengan takdir yang menimpa telah mengurungkan dirinya selama seminggu tanpa bercakap dengan sesiapa. Sebaik Akasyah dengar berita itu, dia telah berkejar ke kampung Suhana dan menyatakan rasa cintanya yang dipendam sejak zaman kolej mereka lagi. Namun pengakuan itu membuatkan Suhana menjadi marah sehingga menghalau Akasyah. Berkat pujukan dan nasihat ibunya, Suhana akhirnya bangkit semula dari kekecewaan itu. Sesampainya di KL dia telah dikejutkan dengan berita Adam yang sakit teruk akibat merindui Suhana.

salamhd.title: Superhero Hati
salamhd.desc: Suhana yang terlalu kecewa dengan takdir yang menimpa telah mengurungkan dirinya selama seminggu tanpa bercakap dengan sesiapa. Sebaik Akasyah dengar berita itu, dia telah berkejar ke kampung Suhana dan menyatakan rasa cintanya yang dipendam sejak zaman kolej mereka lagi. Namun pengakuan itu membuatkan Suhana menjadi marah sehingga menghalau Akasyah. Berkat pujukan dan nasihat ibunya, Suhana akhirnya bangkit semula dari kekecewaan itu. siar.title: Tuah
siar.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

siar.title: Estet
siar.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

siar.title: Darah Satria
siar.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

siar.title: Anak Sarawak
siar.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

siar.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
siar.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan “cool” di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

siar.title: Leftenan Adnan
siar.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

siar.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
siar.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran “Hantu-Hantu Dunia” untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

siar.title: Pecah
siar.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

siar.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
siar.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

siar.title: Jiran
siar.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

duniasinemahd.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

duniasinemahd.title: Adnan Sempit Sawadikap
duniasinemahd.desc: mengisahkan Adnan (Shaheizy Sam) yang lucu, bersama isteri dan anaknya, memulakan perjalanan ke Thailand bersama sahabat baik mereka, Bobby dan Wawa, di mana pelbagai lagi pengembaraan menanti.

duniasinemahd.title: Adnan Sempit Generasi Gig
duniasinemahd.desc: Selepas menyelamatkan Nadia (Afifah Nasir), seorang wanita moden yang telah lama diminatinya, Adnan (Aiman Tino), seorang penghantar makanan, mula jatuh cinta tanpa menyedari bahawa dia mungkin terperangkap dalam rancangan tersembunyi wanita tersebut.

duniasinemahd.title: Kau Langit Aku Laut
duniasinemahd.desc: Kau Langit Aku Laut mengisahkan pasangan kekasih yang mempunyai banyak perbezaan dan sering bergaduh. Mereka cuba pertahankan hubungan walaupun banyak cabaran dan salah faham.

duniasinemahd.title: By My Side
duniasinemahd.desc: Sejak kecil, Faye dan Ben membesar bersama di Subang Jaya dan akhirnya jatuh cinta serta menjalinkan hubungan. Namun hubungan mereka diuji apabila Ben merancang untuk ke Australia, memaksa Faye belajar menghadapi cinta jarak jauh dan kehidupan tanpa dia.

duniasinemahd.title: La Tahzan
duniasinemahd.desc: Mengisahkan Viona, seorang wanita Indonesia yang tinggal di Jepun dan bekerja sebagai pengurus rumah kepada keluarga Muslim. Kehidupannya berubah apabila dia bertemu dengan Hasan, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan kisah silam dan rahsia dalam perkahwinannya. Konflik timbul apabila cinta, kepercayaan dan pengorbanan diuji, membawa Viona kepada perjalanan memahami makna kesabaran, keikhlasan dan ketentuan Tuhan.

duniasinemahd.title: Hello Goodbye
duniasinemahd.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Indra dan Dara, pasangan muda yang berdepan cabaran dalam hubungan mereka apabila impian, jarak dan masalah peribadi mula menguji kekuatan cinta mereka. Kisah ini mengetengahkan tentang pengorbanan, keluarga, harapan serta erti melepaskan seseorang yang disayangi demi kebahagiaan masing-masing.

duniasinemahd.title: 29 Februari
duniasinemahd.desc: Mengisahkan Budi, seorang lelaki yang dilahirkan pada 29 Februari 1896 dan hanya meningkat usia setiap empat tahun sekali. Sepanjang hayatnya, Budi menyaksikan pelbagai perubahan zaman dan kehilangan insan tersayang, sehinggalah dia bertemu cinta sejatinya, Lily, yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya.

duniasinemahd.title: One, Two, Trivia
duniasinemahd.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

duniasinemahd.title: Rock Oo
duniasinemahd.desc: Sekuel kepada Rock, filem ini mengisahkan kumpulan rock Rimba Bara yang bersatu semula untuk mengejar impian muzik dan kembali ke pentas utama di tengah pelbagai cabaran serta gelak-ketawa.

duniasinemahd.title: Rock 4 - Rockers Never Dai
duniasinemahd.desc: Mengisahkan Dio, bekas anggota kumpulan rock legenda Rimba Bara, yang terjaga selepas bertahun-tahun koma akibat kemalangan. Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan

duniasinemahd.title: Rock Bro!
duniasinemahd.desc: Kisah kumpulan rock Rimba Bara meneruskan perjuangan mereka dalam industri muzik, namun konflik muncul apabila Jijoe jatuh cinta kepada legenda rock Ella dan menyebabkan band itu retak serta menimbulkan cabaran baru dalam kerjaya dan persahabatan.

duniasinemahd.title: Srimulat Hidup Memang Komedi
duniasinemahd.desc: Mengisahkan perjalanan awal kumpulan komedi legenda Indonesia, Srimulat, yang berhijrah dari Solo ke Jakarta untuk mengejar impian mencipta nama. Dalam usaha mencapai kejayaan, mereka berdepan pelbagai cabaran, pengorbanan dan konflik, namun terus menghiburkan penonton dengan jenaka dan semangat yang tidak pernah luntur.

pesonahd.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
pesonahd.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

pesonahd.title: Jerit Malam Berujung Cinta
pesonahd.desc: Karina, seorang gadis yang menyertai kelab pencinta alam telah mengalami kejadian misteri semasa aktiviti malam di hutan. Dia telah bertemu dengan Raka, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan rahsia gelap. Pelbagai peristiwa aneh dan menyeramkan mula berlaku, menguji keberanian dan kepercayaan mereka. Dalam usaha untuk menyelamatkan diri, mereka menemui cinta.

pesonahd.title: D'Academy 7 Mega Konser: Cinta Indonesia
pesonahd.desc: Sebuah persembahan muzikal istimewa yang meraikan keindahan dan jiwa bangsa. Konsert khas ini menampilkan alumni D'Academy 7 yang mempersembahkan lagu-lagu patriotik serta lagu rakyat Indonesia popular, dengan susunan baharu berentak dangdut moden. Saksikan malam penuh gemilang yang menyatukan muzik dan budaya, khas dipersembahkan bagi menyemarakkan semangat Cinta Indonesia.

pesonahd.title: Tertawan Hati
pesonahd.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

pesonahd.title: Siapa Takut Orang Ketiga
pesonahd.desc: Kimi tiba di Swiss untuk memulakan hidup barunya dan di sana dia berkenalan dengan William, seorang pelajar Indonesia yang sedang menyelesaikan pengajiannya. William membantu Kimi mendapatkan pekerjaan. Samuel, sahabat Kimi di Indonesia, merasakan Kimi semakin dekat dengan William. Namun, Kimi menyangkal perkara itu. Hakikatnya, Kimi telah menyimpan perasaan kepada Samuel sejak lama.

pesonahd.title: Di Antara Dua Cinta
pesonahd.desc: Pada hari ulang tahun perkahwinan Shafira dan Rafael yang ke-2, Shafira dikejutkan dengan berita bahawa Rafael telah terlibat dalam satu kemalangan, dan jasadnya tidak ditemui. Beberapa tahun berlalu, Rafael akhirnya disahkan meninggal dunia. Shafira kemudian membuat keputusan untuk berkahwin semula dengan Julian. Namun, di puncak kebahagiaan perkahwinan mereka, Rafael tiba-tiba muncul kembali.

Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai D'Academy musim ketujuh?

pesonahd.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

pesonahd.title: D'Academy 7
pesonahd.desc: D' Academy 7 ialah musim ketujuh rancangan nyanyian popular Indonesia yang fokus pada muzik dangdut. Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai D'Academy musim ketujuh?

pesonahd.title: Salingka Bumi Minang
pesonahd.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

pesonahd.title: Aku Terancam Karena Saksi Pengkhianatan
pesonahd.desc: Alika (Cerelia Raissa) dan Rezki (Ichal Muhammad) mula menerima gangguan misteri selepas menjadi saksi kepada hubungan mencurigakan antara Lasti (Larassati Kusnandar) dan Ringga (Rendy Kusdiana). Ketika mereka cuba membongkar kebenaran, Adam (Rizal Akbar) yang mengalami masalah saraf sehingga tidak dapat berjalan, turut menyimpan sesuatu yang mengejutkan. Pelbagai rahsia mula terbongkar apabila mereka semakin hampir dengan kebenaran.

pesonahd.title: D'Academy 7 Mega Konser: Rhomantika Irama
pesonahd.desc: Sebuah persembahan muzik istimewa sebagai penghormatan kepada Raja Dangdut, Rhoma Irama. Konsert khas ini menampilkan alumni D'Academy 7 yang membawakan lagu-lagu malar segar dan irama ikonik beliau, sekali gus menghidupkan nostalgia dengan sentuhan baharu di pentas.

pesonahd.title: Saleha
pesonahd.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

pesonahd.desc: Jelajahi kekayaan masakan yang menampilkan rasa autentik. Sertai kami dalam pengembaraan rasa di seluruh Indonesia, hanya di Makan Terooos, di mana setiap hidangan memiliki kisahnya sendiri.

seti.title: Blessing of Formosa
seti.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

moonbug.title: Blippi Wonders

How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

moonbug.title: Blippi Wonders

After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

The fun at home continues as the kids plan a surprise romantic dinner for Mom and Dad and create a sock puppet show!

moonbug.title: The Melon Patch

From a giant living doll to a runaway magic pet, these cute creatures are causing chaos everywhere!

moonbug.title: CoComelon

moonbug.title: Minibods

moonbug.title: Blippi Wonders

moonbug.title: Digley & Dazey

moonbug.title: Digley & Dazey

moonbug.title: KiiYii

From learning colors to singing a soothing lullaby, these songs will make you feel good!

blippifriends.desc: Get ready for chaos as Magical Pet powers run wild! First, Bubblebear creates so many bubbles that they join together and become a giant Bubble Monster that traps everyone! Then, when Shrubcub gets sick, Pet Port is invaded by wayward vines, and the friends have to race against time to get her some magic tea. The wild powers continue as Slushyseal turns buildings and cars into giant juice pops that start to melt all over town!

blippifriends.title: Antiks
blippifriends.desc: Join Joey and Boo in a series of adventures where everything goes wrong! First, Joey plans the perfect birthday party for Boo, only to forget her present at the last minute! Then, when Boo gets sick, Joey must go on an arduous journey for soup ingredients. The bad luck continues as Joey gets stuck to the back of a spider, they get encased in cement while chasing a berry and they are accidentally rolled up inside a meatball by a dung beetle!

blippifriends.title: Antiks
blippifriends.desc: Join the Antiks on a series of chaotic adventures for delicious food! Whether it's a tantalizing lollipop, a rolling olive, or a crumb from a biscuit, Joey and Boo will do whatever it takes to get it. Their journey is filled with unexpected obstacles, from treacherous sticky tape to menacing fly swatters and even a mind-controlling mushroom. Through teamwork and clever thinking, these tiny heroes face every challenge head-on in a comical pursuit of their next meal.

blippifriends.title: Blippi's Top 10
blippifriends.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite episodes about dinosaurs. He roars, stomps, wiggles, and giggles his way through all things dinosaur! Countdown with him through egg hunts, fossil digs, and dinosaur chases...ROARRRR!

blippifriends.title: Blippi's Top 10
blippifriends.desc: Time for some indoor fun! Blippi is sharing his top 10 favorite visits to amazing indoor playgrounds. Relive the excitement as he explores giant play structures, jumps in colorful ball pits, and zips down super-fast slides. It's a high-energy collection of his most memorable indoor adventures.

blippifriends.title: Gecko's Garage
blippifriends.desc: It's always a busy day at Gecko's Garage! The fun starts when Fiona the Fire Truck arrives with a broken hose that needs a clever fix. Then, Baby Truck comes in after playing in muddy puddles and needs a trip through the car wash machine. The day gets even busier with a late-night emergency wheel change for Bobby, which Gecko must do without waking up the sleeping Mechanicals! Plus, the Mechs have to work as a team when Gecko is feeling unwell.

blippifriends.title: Gecko's Garage
blippifriends.desc: Join Gecko for some of his ultimate rescue missions! Blue must face his fear of a storm to save Eric the Excavator, who is stuck in a trench with a dam about to overflow! Then, Weasel fits Vicky the Ice Cream truck with a super-fast rocket, causing her to speed out of control! Gecko and the Mechanicals must stop her before she crashes. From saving a trapped Mummy Truck to rescuing the Mechs, it's always a big adventure!

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Join Blippi as he visits a construction site to learn all about construction vehicles! In these awesome adventures, Blippi learns all about safety, colors and shapes while exploring the mighty machines. He sees how bucket trucks can help workers reach really high places, like traffic lights. Then, he visits the Port of Olympia to see even more amazing construction vehicles at work! It's a day packed with learning about cool trucks!

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Blippi is going skating on both ice and wheels! First, he meets Olympic gold medalist and professional skateboarder Shaun White to learn all about skateboarding! Blippi learns cool tricks and how to build his own board! Then, it's time to hit the ice as Blippi skates around on an ice rink! He learns about the Zamboni machine before trying his hand at a fun game of ice hockey!

blippifriends.title: CoComelon
blippifriends.desc: Go on a big animal adventure with JJ! The fun starts on Grandpa's farm, where JJ learns all about the animals and the sounds they make. He even helps give a sheep a bath! Then, it's time to head to the ocean. Join JJ and his family as they visit an aquarium and sing 'Baby Shark' with a real shark family! The adventure gets prehistoric when Ms. Appleberry teaches the class all about their favorite dinosaurs. From guessing games to meeting Bingo the dog, it's a wild day!

blippifriends.title: CoComelon
blippifriends.desc: It's time to learn the fundamentals with JJ! Join him and his friends as they practice their numbers by counting baby chicks with Grandpa and singing about five little monkeys jumping on the bed. Then, it's time to learn about colors! Watch as the kids paint plain toy cars with a splash of color and help Ms. Appleberry mix primary colors with jello to make secondary colors. From learning shapes to making yummy rainbow popsicles, this adventure is full of learning fun!

blippifriends.title: Mia's Magic Playground
blippifriends.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

blippifriends.title: Blippi Wonders
blippifriends.desc: Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He and D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety and how a crane works. Then, they meet Frankie the Firetruck to see all of her amazing fire-fighting abilities in action! After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car and a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

blippifriends.title: Blippi Wonders
blippifriends.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He and D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors and why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

blippifriends.title: Oddbods
blippifriends.desc: The Oddbods are in a real panic! First, Fuse and Pogo find themselves stranded inside Jeff's house after he goes on holiday. They must find a way to get along until Jeff gets back! Then, Fuse is rescued by Newt from an embarrassing situation and takes it upon himself to repay the debt by becoming her hero. Finally, one of Bubbles' experiments ends up in Pogo's ice cream, and his customers start to experience terrible side effects!

blippifriends.title: Oddbods
blippifriends.desc: Get ready for some technological mayhem with the Oddbods! What's more annoying than Pogo? Another Pogo! He finds Bubbles' cloning machine and decides to make a copy of himself for double the pranks. Then, he uses an invisibility device to cause all sorts of havoc in Oddsville, making his neighbors think they're being haunted by ghosts! Plus, Slick orders a robot buddy, but it malfunctions and causes trouble.

blippifriends.title: Supa Strikas
blippifriends.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

blippifriends.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Join Blippi for a prehistoric dino adventure at the Pacific Science Center in Seattle! Before he travels back in time, he starts by exploring a beautiful butterfly enclosure and seeing some cool fish in the aquarium. Then, it's time to learn all about prehistoric dinosaurs! In this super educational episode, Blippi discovers amazing facts about these ancient creatures. There is so much to learn and explore!

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Blippi has a fun-filled vehicle day! He visits Sun Buggy, learning to ride over giant sandy hills in ATVs, UTVs and Dune Buggies for a fast day in the sun. Then he has a big day out at a truck garage, discovering the lifts used to hold cars up in the air and all of the cool tools that help mechanics make repairs, Blippi realizes taking care of cars take a lot of hard work.

blippifriends.title: Little Angel
blippifriends.desc: Sing along to Baby John's favorite animal songs! First, the kids welcome a new puppy named Bingo to the family and sing the classic nursery rhyme about him! Then, the family acts out the story of Humpty Dumpty Sat on a Wall. The animal fun continues as Baby John spends the day at the aquarium and runs into Baby Shark! He learns the 'Baby Shark' dance and has an exciting dance marathon! Plus, the family dresses up like little dinosaurs!

blippifriends.title: Little Angel
blippifriends.desc: Open up Baby John's Big Book of Safety and learn along with him! First, the family learns they must remember their helmets to stay safe on a fun family bike ride. Then, it's time for a trip to the beach, where Mom and Dad teach the kids how to have fun and stay safe as they enjoy the sun and sand. The safety lessons continue at the pool, where Baby John learns the importance of following the rules when swimming.

blippifriends.title: Meekah
blippifriends.desc: Join Meekah for a fun day at Jumper Jungle indoor playground! On a day of sporty play, Meekah finds different sports balls, including a basketball and a soccer ball. As she collects them, she searches for the best place to play each sports game. Then, it's a day of bouncy play! Join Meekah as she bounces around the inflatable play structures and bounces like a bunny, frolics like a frog and hops like a hare!

blippifriends.title: Meekah
blippifriends.desc: Join Meekah for a land, sea and space extravaganza! First, she boards the Intrepid aircraft carrier for an air and sea adventure! She explores an airplane, a helicopter and learns about life as a sailor. Then, 3-2-1 Blast Off! Astronaut Meekah zooms around the Columbia Memorial Space Center. She builds a model of Apollo 11, watches a parachute sail to the ground, programs a Mars Rover and makes gooey slime for Blippi!

blippifriends.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
blippifriends.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Blippi and Meekah are learning how to be firefighters! Their adventure starts with a tour of a New York City Fire Station, where they see old fire vehicles, ring the alarm bells and even try on firefighter uniforms. Then, Blippi visits the exciting city of Kidzania to continue his training. After learning about fire safety, he gets to ride in a firetruck and handle the hose to put out a simulated fire. It's an action-packed day of learning and fun!

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Join Blippi on some awesome artistic adventures! First, he visits Boise Art Glass, where he looks at beautiful glass sculptures and chandeliers. Blippi then works with an in-house glass blower to create his very own orange and blue bowl! The artistic fun continues as Blippi visits a flying yoga studio to learn how to dance in the air! Using a silk, he learns tricks and dance moves from an aerial dance instructor.

blippifriends.title: Oddbods
blippifriends.desc: The cul-de-sac is dealing with some new arrivals! First, there's an alien invader, in the form of a popcorn-obsessed creature that has cloned itself to look exactly like Newt, who is trapped on its spaceship! Then, Zee has the misfortune of having to babysit his disruptive niece and nephew who seem intent on wrecking both his home and his head! Plus, a pleasant afternoon barbecue takes a turn for the worse for Jeff.

blippifriends.title: Oddbods
blippifriends.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! Ashamed by another angry outburst, Fuse decides to reinvent himself as a brand new, calmer Oddbod. How will the others take to this new character? Then, Bubbles is in full detective mode when things are stolen from the Oddbods while they sleep. But will she like what she finds? The trouble continues when Jeff's meddling accidentally turns Bubbles back into a baby-bod!

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Join Blippi and Meekah as they learn to be on wheels! They visit Moonlight Rollerway to learn all about roller skating safely. Then Blippi joins a roller derby team to master the basics, work on his balance and prepare for a wild ride, with his helmet on, knees padded and laces tied!

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Blippi has a day full of adventure and fun! First he joins his Brave Wilderness friend Mark Vins to explore a vibrant rainforest in Costa Rica, searching for frogs and collecting tadpoles from a pond. Afterwards it's time for an under-the-sea foam party with Meekah, complete with imaginary water, hide-and-seek with a crab and a big dance party with bubbles.

blippifriends.title: Meekah
blippifriends.desc: Is Meekah up for the ultimate dance challenge? When her Dino Buddy wants to be a musician, Meekah takes her to a music studio to create a song and learn about counting beats. Then, she learns the foundations of gymnastics, like how to do a forward roll and walk on the balance beam. Finally, she visits an awesome indoor playground, where she plays a fun game where she has to dance her way to each of the different play areas!

blippifriends.title: Meekah
blippifriends.desc: It's Monster Jammin time with Meekah! First, she watches a skid steer challenge a monster truck to a donut challenge! This gives her a great idea to use her Wonder Watch to shrink the trucks and have her own mini Jam. Then, it's a dancing scavenger hunt as Meekah digs her way around a construction site to see her favorite trucks on the move. As she follows Blippi's construction truck map, she creates a dance by watching each vehicle work.

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Blippi is ready to make a splash! He has fun at Aquatica Park, learning water safety from a lifeguard and trying out amazing water slides including a rainbow one. He continues his day of water play at Yas Waterworld, experiencing fast slides and splishing and splashing through the park. Blippi also makes new animal friends at NatureWorks as part of his day of discovery!

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Join Blippi for a day of prehistoric and geological wonders! The adventure starts with a visit to the active Kilauea volcano in Hawaii where Blippi explores plant and animal life around a crater with a local tour guide. Then he travels back in time at the Orlando Science Center where he learns about fossils, growls like a dinosaur and meets a giant T-Rex and a Triceratops with three enormous horns.

blippifriends.title: Insectibles
blippifriends.desc: The Insectibles are in double trouble! First, when Adilla captures the team, Zak must go on a lone mission to save them. He finds a wise Praying Mantis who teaches him the art of kung-fu so he can confront the roaches and free his friends! Meanwhile, Willow, Chowser and Syd find themselves stuck to a powerful bar magnet trap set by Adilla in her tower. It's up to Gramps' clever tinkering to cause some unexpected magnetic mayhem and help them escape!

blippifriends.title: Insectibles
blippifriends.desc: The Insectibles are split into two desperate missions! After a trek through a strange mushroom patch turns most of the gang into mindless zombies, Zak and Willow must form a reluctant alliance with Adilla to find a cure. At the same time, Chowser, lured by a chunk of cheese, falls into a trap and is taken captive by Fred. The remaining team members must now race to save their friend from Fred's secret tunnel while also dealing with the zombie plague.

blippifriends.title: Insectibles
blippifriends.desc: The Insectibles devise a clever plan to infiltrate the roaches' camp: they'll go undercover as a traveling theater troupe. While they distract the roaches with a dramatic performance, Syd sneaks around back to find a hidden Shrinkinator part. But when Zak's ego gets the best of him during a battle with the roach brothers, he loses the part they just recovered. Now, a humbled Zak must disguise himself as a cockroach to sneak into their boot camp and retrieve it alone.

blippifriends.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures

Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

blippifriends.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! When Zee is caught 'borrowing' electricity from Jeff, Jeff makes him clean up his messy house as payment. Then, Slick and Pogo get into a battle of 'one-upmanship' over who is the neighborhood's resident superhero, but their competition is less than heroic. The day gets even stranger when Newt finds a four-leaf clover and has an amazing run of good luck!

blippifriends.title: Oddbods
blippifriends.desc: The Oddbods are facing some tricky problems! Newt discovers an abandoned bird egg and hopes to hatch it, but she is distressed to discover that Fuse is tasked with chopping down the tree it's in! Then, a snowy day gives Pogo the perfect chance for new pranks, but he goes too far and is sent to a boot camp to learn discipline. Plus, Newt struggles with building a flatpack treehouse and gets some unwanted 'help' from Fuse.

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Join Blippi for a fun hiking and camping adventure! First, Blippi goes for a hike in Priest Point Park, where he learns all about hiking and what you need to know before setting off! He learns about colors, shapes, nature and hiking safety! Then, Blippi explores the great outdoors as he goes on a camping trip! Blippi shows us how to set up a campsite and how to build a tent, before making some tasty s'mores!

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: Blippi learns all about bowling in this episode featuring the great indoors. There's always fun to be had even when the weather doesn't cooperate and Blippi knows just how to find it! Blippi learns the proper way to roll a bowling ball and how to knock down the pins for a strike!

blippifriends.title: Oddbods
blippifriends.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new obsessions! Jeff is convinced that Pogo is responsible for the theft of a bale of straw from his garden, but no one believes him. Jeff begins an obsessive quest to clear his name and prove that Pogo is behind it all! Then, feeling emasculated, Jeff seeks Fuse's help to teach him to be stronger and more macho. But it's not long before his new macho-ness becomes a problem.

blippifriends.title: Oddbods
blippifriends.desc: The Oddbods are having a very busy day! Zee needs some money, so he does some odd jobs, but his laziness makes him a less-than-ideal employee. Then, after a near-accident, Bubbles creates a health serum to improve a cow's intelligence, but a guinea pig eats it instead and develops a super-brain! Finally, it's photo day, and Slick is determined to make sure he's front and center in the picture this year.

blippifriends.title: Morphle
blippifriends.desc: Mila and Morphle are turning little problems into big adventures! When Mr. Vanderboos accidentally sprays hair growth serum on Daddy, Officer Freeze mistakes him for a hairy monster, and a wild chase begins! Then, Mila has a bad cold, but she still has to help Morphle figure out the right morphs to rescue a dog stuck in a tree. From playing a quiet game to avoid waking a napping neighbor to playing hide and seek with friends, every little problem is a big adventure!

blippifriends.title: Morphle
blippifriends.desc: Get ready for an action-packed day of battling evil robots and racing villains! First, the new and improved Robofreeze becomes faulty, and Mila and Morphle must help Officer Freeze retrieve the remote to turn him off! Then, it's time for the Pet Port Rally, but naughty Winston cheats by using sneaky devices to slow everyone down. The chaos continues as two Robofreezes turn evil and multiply, and a lightning strike turns another one into a super-powered menace!

blippifriends.title: Antiks
blippifriends.desc: Spring has sprung, and so have the Antiks! Join them as they explore a world of blossoming flowers and fresh spring treats. From climbing giant mushrooms to navigating through a garden of delights, their adventures are as colorful as the season. It's a story about discovery, teamwork, and enjoying the sweet tastes of spring.

blippifriends.title: Antiks
blippifriends.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. Then, they struggle to move a giant piece of candy until they eat some of it, giving them super speed! The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

blippifriends.title: Blippi's Top 10
blippifriends.desc: It's an adventurous kind of day for Blippi as he remembers his top ten favorite moments at Amusement and Water Parks! Join Blippi as he rides on spinning tea cups, goes on roller coasters, slides down water slides and even learns about under water safety.

blippifriends.title: Blippi's Top 10
blippifriends.desc: Racecars, firetrucks, construction vehicles... oh my! Blippi loves learning about vehicles of all shapes and sizes, so he's excited to share his top ten moments in a vehicle! From go-karts to rocketships, and even a Monster Jam truck, these are his favorite vehicle adventures!

blippifriends.title: Gecko's Garage
blippifriends.desc: Grandma Gecko is here to help with some epic rescues! The action starts when Weasel's accelerator gets stuck and he can't stop driving! Grandma Gecko and Gecko hop on a motorbike for a high-speed chase to save him. Then, when lots of vehicles get flat tires from nails on the road, Gecko feels the pressure and calls his Grandma to help him speedily change all the tires. From building a wind turbine to saving Blue, Grandma can do it all!

blippifriends.title: Gecko's Garage
blippifriends.desc: Get ready for epic rescues and Mr. Weasel's hilarious fails! The chaos begins when Weasel fills Max the Monster Truck's tires with helium, causing him to float away and forcing Gecko to perform a sky-high rescue! Then, Weasel's plan to give Molly extra bouncy springs goes wrong, and Gecko has to help her stop bouncing. The rescues continue when Weasel's new electro-magnet sucks up Baby Truck and the Mechanicals, and Gecko has to save the day!

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: All aboard! Join Blippi for an amazing vehicle adventure on land and sea! First, Blippi takes a tour of a steam train! He gets to learn how steam trains used to work and honks the horn! Then, he visits a bus depot to learn more about buses. He learns about the engine, rides the bus around town and sings a song! Finally, Blippi takes to the sea to learn about boats and gets to explore the inside of a luxurious speedboat.

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: It's time to learn all about planes with Blippi! First, he's at Erin Air in Seattle, WA, and he's ready to explore a private jet! After learning about the different types of planes and making sure everything is good to go, it's time for takeoff! Then, Blippi visits another airfield to learn even more about planes! Blippi soars high above the city while taking a plane ride and then sings the popular Plane Song!

blippifriends.title: CoComelon
blippifriends.desc: Spend a whole day with JJ, from morning to night! Wake up and get ready with the family as JJ learns his morning routine. Then, it's off to a big adventure: JJ's first day of preschool! He's a little nervous, but he makes new friends and has lots of fun. After a full day of playing, it's time to get ready for bed. Mommy guides JJ through his nighttime routine of brushing his teeth, taking a bath and reading a story before he drifts off to sleep.

blippifriends.title: CoComelon
blippifriends.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

blippifriends.desc: It's time for Blippi to get curious and creative! A mysterious book appears in the clubhouse, and when Blippi opens it, the brand-new Curiosity Crew jumps out! After helping the crew figure out what they're looking for (popsicles!), Blippi and Meekah join them on some creative adventures. They learn all about how to mix colors to make a beautiful rainbow painting, shrink down to dance with Bendjamin the Klutz and ride a library cart on a hunt for books about dinosaurs!

blippifriends.title: Blippi Wonders
blippifriends.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

blippifriends.title: Oddbods
blippifriends.desc: The Oddbods are facing some challenging situations! When Fuse gets a birthday present of a skydiving ticket, he's too proud to tell Bubbles he's scared of heights and tries to face his fears. Then, Zee is cupcake crazy! When he discovers Bubbles is running a cupcake factory out of her house, he finds it impossible to control himself. The challenges continue when Newt crashes one of Fuse's fishing expeditions and turns out to be a natural!

blippifriends.desc: Neither snow nor rain can stop the mail! Blippi is learning all about the journey a letter takes. He visits a post office to see how mail is sorted and then learns about the important job of a mail carrier. It's a special delivery of fun and facts about the postal service.

blippifriends.title: Blippi
blippifriends.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? Join Blippi as he explores different, exciting occupations through play! At the Children's Museum of Idaho, he discovers what it's like to be a pilot and a veterinarian. The exploration continues at the Hawaii Children's Discovery Center, where he does a 'special report' on even more jobs! He reads the news like a TV anchor, drives a fire truck and sorts letters like a mail carrier.

filemmantap.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche

pluto-tv-trending-now.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

pluto-tv-trending-now.title: Old School
pluto-tv-trending-now.desc: Three men are disenchanted with life and try to recapture their college days.

pluto-tv-trending-now.title: Transformers
pluto-tv-trending-now.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

pluto-tv-trending-now.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
pluto-tv-trending-now.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

cine-adrenalina.title: Hombres de élite
cine-adrenalina.desc: En este tenso thriller protagonizado por John Travolta y Kate Bosworth, un equipo de trabajadores de líneas eléctricas de Texas se apresura a instalar kilómetros de cable antes de que una mortal tormenta eléctrica destruya la red eléctrica.

cine-adrenalina.title: Equilibrium (ESP)
cine-adrenalina.desc: En el futuro, la humanidad ha prohibido cosas que producen emociones como la literatura, la música y el arte, para mantenerlo, un grupo especial de policías eliminará a los transgresores. Christian Bale protagoniza esta increíble película de acción.

cine-adrenalina.title: Resultado final
cine-adrenalina.desc: Después de que terroristas mortales secuestran a su sobrina en un partido de fútbol, un ex soldado con habilidades de combate letales (Dave Bautista) libra una guerra de un solo hombre para salvarla y evitar la destrucción masiva.

cine-adrenalina.title: Instinto predador
cine-adrenalina.desc: Un cazador (Nicolas Cage) debe luchar por su vida en un barco cuando sus mortíferos animales -entre ellos un raro jaguar blanco- son soltados por un peligroso criminal que quiere matar a todos a bordo.

cine-adrenalina.title: Memoria perdida
cine-adrenalina.desc: Lauren pierde la memoria después de un accidente; poco a poco va recordando lo que pasó hasta darse cuenta de que su hija está desaparecida. Ahora debe ayudar a la policía a encontrarla.

cine-adrenalina.title: La suburban dorada
cine-adrenalina.desc: Un policía judicial es acusado de estar relacionado con el narcotráfico sólo por ayudar a su primo. Las circunstancias lo convierten en un fugitivo de la ley y por recuperar a su hijo tiene que involucrase con el narco.

cine-adrenalina.desc: Para buscar justicia por el asesinato de su compañero, un agente de policía de Copenhague (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) y un compañero se embarcan en una misión mortal para dar caza a un misterioso hombre en este trepidante thriller de acción.

cine-adrenalina.title: Caza Terrorista
cine-adrenalina.desc: Nicolas Cage enciende un barril de pólvora de acción mientras un veterano agente de la CIA va a la caza de su némesis, un terrorista mortal.

cine-premiere.desc: En el tiempo de las mariposas es una novela de la escritora dominicana Julia Álvarez, publicada en 1994, sobre la historia de las hermanas Mirabal.

cine-premiere.title: Frida (ESP)
cine-premiere.desc: Salma Hayek triunfa en esta película biográfica de una mujer excepcional que vivió una vida inolvidable, Frida Kahlo. Está dirigida por Julie Taymor y cuenta con un elenco de apoyo que incluye a Alfred Molina, Antonio Banderas y Diego Luna.

cine-premiere.title: Alto impacto
cine-premiere.desc: Ganadora de 3 Premios Óscar, incluida Mejor Película, un accidente une a varios desconocidos en Los Ángeles.

cine-premiere.desc: Una detective de policía reconecta con gente relacionada con una misión encubierta de hace años para encontrar paz.

cine-premiere.desc: Con un asesino serial suelto y un desconocido acosando a su familia, una esposa dedicada revela un secreto sobre su marido que amenaza su matrimonio y sus vidas.

cine-premiere.title: Por un puñado de dólares
cine-premiere.desc: El mítico “Hombre sin nombre”: Clint Eastwood hace un debut impresionante en esta historia apasionante y llena de acción de la nueva generación del viejo Oeste (Heraldo Cinematográfico) por el aclamado director de la película: El bueno, el malo y el feo.

cine-premiere.title: Zulú
cine-premiere.desc: En un Sudáfrica post-apartheid, dos policías superan sus diferencias pasadas para unirse en la lucha contra el crimen. Una emocionante historia de redención y justicia.

cine-premiere.desc: Siga esta historia aclamada por la crítica sobre el amor, la lealtad y la elección que un hijo debe hacer entre honrar a su familia y seguir su corazón.
